Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your data
Privacy.intro: Drawery respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you use our service, how we use it, and the rights you have over your data.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and a hashed password (if you sign up with email/password).
When you sign in with Google, GitHub, or Facebook, we receive your name, email, and public profile picture from that provider, within the scope of permissions you granted.
We collect additional information you choose to provide, such as your phone number, a short bio, and an uploaded profile picture.

sections.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
paragraphs: We use session cookies to keep you signed in between visits.
We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies for marketing purposes.

sections.title: Sharing Information with Third Parties
paragraphs: We do not sell or rent your personal data to any third party.
Your data is stored on MongoDB Atlas and Vercel Blob (for profile pictures) infrastructure — these providers process data on our behalf, subject to their own privacy policies.
We may share information if required by law, or to protect the legal rights of Drawery and our users.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain your account information for as long as your account remains active.
After you delete your account, your personal data will be permanently removed from our systems within 30 days, unless a longer retention period is required by law.

sections.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: You may access and update your personal information at any time from your Profile page.
You may request the deletion of your entire account and associated data through the account deletion feature in the app.
You may unlink any sign-in method (Google, GitHub, Facebook) as long as at least one other method remains linked to your account.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our service is not intended for users under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children under this age.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. Any material changes will be communicated via email or an in-app notice.

Privacy.contactDesc: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at
